newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 24.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of the Philippine stocks on Tuesday and main factors likely to affect trading.

*Manila stocks are likely to continue to fall on Tuesday due to jitters over second quarter corporate earnings and in sympathy with the steep drop overnight of the Dow Jones index, Anscor Hagedorn vice president Noel Reyes said.
"The economy seems to be consolidating and corporate earnings in the second quarter may not be so bright," Reyes said.
* Traders said they expected the index to form a floor at the 2,750 level.
* The Philippine composite index dropped 73.08 points to 2,808.65 on Monday.
* On Monday, the Dow Jones tumbled 192.25 points to 7,604.26.
* North Negros Marketing Corp, a unit of cash-strapped Victorias Milling Co Inc, is seeking suspension of payments for its 1.86 billion pesos worth of debts, Philippine newspapers reported.

* Petron's fuel production will drop by 10,000 barrels daily for a month as a result of the breakdown last Friday of its catalytic reformer, an equipment used to process gasoline and other petroleum products, Philippine newspapers said.

* Treasury bill rates went up across the board by almost half a percentage point as an offshoot of last week's decision of the Central Bank to jack up its overnight borrowing rate to defend the peso against speculative attack.
